instructions_en: Excavate a 40 metre drainage trench along grid line 12 at Pit B north bench. Maintain a depth of 1.8 metres and a width of 1.2 metres. Stockpile the spoil three metres clear of the trench edge so the loader can pick it up later.
safety_note_en: Underground cable marked in yellow paint runs parallel at 2 metres. Keep the bucket clear of the marking and stop work if you see any cable.

instructions_en: Load overburden from the north stockpile into haul trucks as they arrive. Target twelve trucks before the lunch break. Keep the bucket fill factor above ninety percent and avoid spillage on the haul road.
safety_note_en: Never swing the bucket over the truck cab. Wait for the driver's horn signal before you start loading.

title_en: Clear loose material from the ramp
instructions_en: Clear loose rock and spillage from the access ramp so the water tanker can pass. Push the material to the toe of the bench and level the surface.
safety_note_en: Ramp gradient is steep. Track straight up and down, never across the slope.

title_en: Feed the crusher from the aggregate stockpile
instructions_en: Feed the primary crusher hopper from the twenty millimetre aggregate stockpile. Keep the hopper at least half full at all times and target one hundred and sixty buckets for the shift.
safety_note_en: Do not approach the hopper edge closer than one machine length. Keep the three point contact rule while entering the cab.

title_en: Load dispatch trucks with washed sand
instructions_en: Load the dispatch trucks with washed sand from bay three. Each truck takes six buckets. Confirm the weight on the payload display before releasing the truck.
safety_note_en: Check the payload display for every load. Overloading a dispatch truck is a reportable violation.

title_en: Grade and maintain the haul road
instructions_en: Grade haul road section four and push the windrow material back onto the running surface. Maintain a two percent camber so water drains to the side drain.
safety_note_en: Water tanker is operating on the same section. Stay in radio contact on channel four before you reverse.
